name: Spiritist of Crescentfall
source:
The ghosts of the past and the prospect of change, can oftentimes be a lot to handle. Follow the titular Spiritist of Crescentfall and the spirit that is anchored to him, as he helps the townfolk with their problems, all while dark clouds gather over the town.

[From [url=https://c-mooon.itch.io/spiritist-of-crecentfall]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
过去的阴影和未来的变化往往是一件需要处理的事情。跟随新月镇的招魂师和他身上的灵魂，帮助镇民解决他们的问题，同时乌云笼罩着小镇。

[来自[url=https://c-mooon.itch.io/spiritist-of-crecentfall]Itch.io[/url]]
